title: Fan-out workers page through followers, and a retried batch is harmless
caption: The worker commits its progress only after a batch is written, and timeline entries are keyed by post id, so a redelivered batch is a no-op.

messages.label: add p9 to 1 000 timelines
messages.note: One pipelined batch, not 1 000 round trips.

messages.label: crash before recording progress
messages.note: The event is redelivered to another worker, which starts again at page 1.

messages.label: add p9 to the same 1 000 again
messages.note: Each timeline is a set keyed by post id, so p9 is already there. No duplicates.

messages.label: followers of ann, page 2…
messages.note: Continues until the follower list runs out, then commits the event.

scenarios.name: Non-idempotent append
scenarios.summary: Same crash, but timelines are plain lists: the retry appends p9 again, and 1 000 followers see the post twice. Key entries by post id.

messages.label: LPUSH p9 to 1 000 timelines
messages.note: A list append, not a set insert.

messages.label: LPUSH p9 to the same 1 000
messages.note: The redelivered event repeats page 1. Every one of those timelines now holds p9 twice.

scenarios.name: Alternative: checkpoint
scenarios.summary: Save a cursor after every page: a retry resumes where the last worker stopped instead of at page 1. Less repeated work, one more write per page.

messages.label: save cursor: p9 → page 2
messages.note: Progress is stored after each page is written.

messages.label: load cursor for p9 → page 2
messages.note: The next worker reads the cursor and skips page 1.

messages.label: add p9 to page 2 (1 000)
messages.note: At most one page is repeated, and set inserts keep even that harmless.

scenarios.name: Big author: split the job
scenarios.summary: 40 M followers is 40 000 pages. One worker would take ages, so a planner splits the list into ranges that many workers process in parallel.

messages.label: post p9 by a big author
follower count → 40 M
messages.note: Too many for one worker to page through in order.

messages.label: publish 400 range jobs
messages.note: Each job covers 100 000 followers (100 pages) and is retried on its own.

messages.label: range job 17 → any worker
messages.note: Hundreds of workers run ranges in parallel. Above the hybrid threshold you'd skip this entirely.
